Loyalty · Packs · What Stays When Everything Else Leaves

Formed from countless loyal animal souls who refused to leave their dying handlers' sides even when the radiation, the cold, or the raiders came for them too. She rewards bonds that hold and never forgives one broken by choice — abandon a Feral Bond that trusted you, and bad luck follows every partnership you try to build afterward.

Favored patron of Waywardens specifically, though any beast-keeper in the wasteland knows her name.

CROSS-CLASS — usable setting-wide as a petty-god patron for any class that keeps an animal, construct, or bound companion; the Waywarden is simply the one with a feat chain built to use her directly.
